title: Silver sword

infobox.Crafting Materials: Wood x3, Silver x60, Leather scraps x3, Iron x9

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Silver sword is the third sword.
• Primary attack is a 3-hit combo with double damage on the last hit. No damage penalty against multiple targets.
• Secondary attack deals 3x damage with a slightly longer reach.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The spirit damage on the weapon only affects undead and demon enemies. This makes higher physical damage dealing swords such as the Black metal sword better for general use.
• Spirit damage is not instant damage, but a ticking (and stacking) debuff like fire.
• Silver sword has currently the highest spirit damage of any weapon in the game.

Introduction. The Silver sword is the third sword.
• Primary attack is a 3-hit combo with double damage on the last hit. No damage penalty against multiple targets.
• Secondary attack deals 3x damage with a slightly longer reach.

Notes. • The spirit damage on the weapon only affects undead and demon enemies. This makes higher physical damage dealing swords such as the Black metal sword better for general use.
• Spirit damage is not instant damage, but a ticking (and stacking) debuff like fire.
• Silver sword has currently the highest spirit damage of any weapon in the game.
